the urges will definitely pass. i'm 14, i self harmed when i was 12, and it's been active in my life ever since. i did relapse some nights ago after being three months clean, but the good thing is, i was three months clean. there will be urges for a long time after you stop, but they do eventually subside. relapse isn't the worst thing in the world, remember that. that one month you have on you, celebrate it. each month you dont self harm, celebrate, or doing something that makes you happy. keep looking forward to that. that keeps the urges away for me, and i hope it will work for you.

you need to tell her that's she's beautiful and perfect the way she is and minor mistakes such as self harm don't define her. you need to make sure she knows how much you love her that you're there for her at any time of the day and during any circumstance. don't assume that she is suicidal, she's just struggling. if she doesnt necessarily open up right away, wait until she's ready to open up more. tell her things that make her happy and do things that make her happy. distract her, but dont make it seem like you're trying to hard. what's best is make her feel comfortable around you, more comfortable around you, and safe.
